theorem algebra_ineq_nto1onlt2m1on
  (n : ℕ) :
  (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) ≤ 2 - 1 / (n : ℝ) := by
  by_cases h0 : n = 0
  · subst h0
    norm_num
  · have hn_pos : n ≥ 1 := by
      contrapose! h0
      omega
    by_cases h1 : n = 1
    · subst h1
      norm_num [Real.rpow_one]
    · have hn_ge_2 : n ≥ 2 := by
        omega
      have h_n_le_pow : (n : ℝ) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
        have h_aux : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≥ 2 → (k : ℝ) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
          intro k hk
          induction' hk with k hk IH
          · norm_num
          · have h_k_ge_2 : k ≥ 2 := by omega
            have h_k_pos : (k : ℝ) ≥ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hk
            calc
              (k + 1 : ℝ) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) := by
                have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
                nlinarith
              _ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) := by
                gcongr
                exact IH
              _ = (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
                rw [mul_comm, ← pow_succ]
        exact h_aux n hn_ge_2
      have h_n_rpow_le_3_2 : (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) ≤ 3 / 2 := by
        have h₁ : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by
          norm_cast
          omega
        calc
          (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) ≤ ((3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) := by
            gcongr
            exact_mod_cast h_n_le_pow
          _ = ((3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) := by rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
          _ = (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) * (1 / (n : ℝ))) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity)]
            <;> field_simp [h₁.ne']
          _ = (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 1 := by
            field_simp [h₁.ne']
            <;> ring_nf
          _ = 3 / 2 := by norm_num
      have h_3_2_le_2_minus_1_over_n : (3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 - 1 / (n : ℝ) := by
        have h₁ : (n : ℝ) ≥ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hn_ge_2
        have h₂ : 1 / (n : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
          apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le
          · positivity
          · linarith
        norm_num at h₂ ⊢
        linarith
      calc
        (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) ≤ 3 / 2 := h_n_rpow_le_3_2
        _ ≤ 2 - 1 / (n : ℝ) := h_3_2_le_2_minus_1_over_n
